STATEMENT: A worker SHALL perform only work covered by its current assignment.
Raising a bug records and routes a defect; it expressly prohibits investigation or repair until Development Manager assigns work covering that bug.
Completion claims require current evidence from the authoritative source state and applicable qualification procedures.
Development tools SHALL be qualified by running them against the development framework itself before they are accepted.
Public source files, classes and methods are incomplete while required documentation is missing or stale.
A qualified specialist bootstrap is durable domain knowledge; later package revisions SHALL update from source deltas rather than paying to rediscover the package from scratch.
Tests execute on leased test resources; a development workspace is not implicitly a test resource.
All ED209 host command and file-transfer access SHALL be mediated by sshnode.sh; workers SHALL NOT invent alternate SSH/SCP/cloud-shell paths.
Where a cloud has multiple provider accounts, every control-plane operation SHALL name and verify the provider account explicitly; ambient cloud identity is not authority.
Deploy-to-test SHALL preserve evidence before cleanup and SHALL revoke temporary network exposure and release resource/WLU leases even after test failure.
Substantive worker execution requires an active admitted work.load.units/0.12 reservation; provider/model binding alone never grants permission to execute.

WLU remains work authority. Dollars, tokens, GPU seconds, wall time, bytes and other resource quantities remain native accounting units correlated to the WLU reservation; they are not converted into fictional WLU by the Development Floor ledger.
Every admitted assignment must settle or release its WLU reservation, including failure and cleanup paths; consumed work is never refunded merely because the remainder is released.
